meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档变成可爱的幻灯片 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把文档快速变成可分享的叙事幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute slide-deck PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly turn a document into shareable narrative slides

howto.what: 将你提供的一个文档（如报告、文章）转换成一份可爱的幻灯片 PDF，并生成一个手机端可分享的链接。
howto.when: 当你对 Claude 说“wowerpoint 这个文件”、“把这个报告做成幻灯片”等类似指令时触发。

say.text: wowerpoint 这份市场分析报告
say.note: Claude 会读取文档并生成幻灯片 PDF 和分享链接。

say.text: 把这份会议纪要变成幻灯片
say.note: Claude 会处理文档并输出幻灯片。

howto.what_en: Converts a single document (e.g., report, article) into a cute slide-deck PDF and generates a mobile-friendly share link.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or similar requests.

say_en.note: Claude will read the document and produce slides plus a share link.

say_en.text: Turn this meeting minutes into slides
say_en.note: Claude will process the document and output slides.
